title: Man of the Year
description: Tom Dobbs (Robin Williams), the satirical host of a political talk show, runs for U.S. president and unexpectedly wins.

title: The Host
description: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.

title: Judgment Night
description: On their way to a boxing match, four young men take a wrong turn in Chicago and find danger as witnesses to murder.

title: Red Riding: 1980
description: Detective Peter Hunter returns to Yorkshire to investigate the town's high murder rate. The local police have done little to find the killer, and he soon realizes corrupt police officers are doing everything they can to stop his progress.

title: Prison on Fire
description: Sentenced to two years for accidentally killing a robber, a man (Tony Leung Ka Fai) befriends another prisoner (Chow Yun-Fat) who helps protect him.

title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
description: In the 19th century, a buxom woman (Cassandra Peterson) of mystery and shtick visits a castle inhabited by a fatally cursed family.

title: The Real Blonde
description: An aspiring actor (Matthew Modine) and his girlfriend (Catherine Keener) handle life's frustrations, while his friend seeks fulfillment with a blonde (Daryl Hannah).

title: Infernal Affairs III
description: Ten months after the murder of Yan, Ming is set to work on mundane office duties; Yeung reminds Ming of his own suspicious rise to fame.

title: Standing Up, Falling Down
description: A failing stand-up comedian and an alcoholic dermatologist give each other the confidence to face the failures in their lives.

title: Hoop Dreams
description: Filmmakers chronicle more than four years in the lives of two urban Chicago youths in pursuit of pro basketball stardom.

title: The Bodyguard
description: Kiba is back again, but this time he has fallen from grace and been sent to prison for all the violent acts he has committed. Once he's out, he begins working as a bodyguard in a club that is crawling with gangsters.

title: Marlowe
description: Detective Philip Marlowe becomes embroiled in an investigation with a wealthy family in Bay City, Calif., after a beautiful blonde hires him to find her former lover.

title: Brain on Fire
description: Susannah Cahalan, an up-and-coming journalist at the New York Post, became plagued by voices in her head and seizures. As weeks progress and Susannah quickly moves deeper into insanity, her behaviors shift from violence to catatonia.

title: Hard-Boiled
description: A police officer and an undercover colleague embark on a blood-splattered quest to crush a gun smuggling ring.

title: I'm Charlie Walker
description: Trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker fights institutional racism while cleaning up a massive oil spill off the coast of San Francisco in 1971.

title: The Rising Hawk
description: During the 13th century, a small village fights for freedom in the frontier landscape of the Carpathian Mountains against Mongolian invaders.

title: The Company
description: A young woman (Neve Campbell) works as a nightclub waitress while becoming a rising ballerina in Chicago.

title: The Rookies
description: An extreme sports athlete joins a mysterious special agent and her ragtag team of recruits to battle a group of deadly terrorists.

title: Freejack
description: Bounty hunters from the future transport a doomed race car driver to New York City in 2009, where his mind will be replaced with that of a dead billionaire.

title: Deathstalker II
description: Hero Deathstalker (John Terlesky) helps Princess Evie (Monique Gabrielle) reclaim her throne from a sorcerer (John La Zar) and his Princess Evie clone.

title: Good Fences
description: A black attorney (Danny Glover), his wife (Whoopi Goldberg) and their two children move to a posh neighborhood in Greenwich, Conn.

title: Studio 666
description: Legendary rock band Foo Fighters move into an Encino mansion steeped in grisly rock and roll history to record their much anticipated 10th album.

title: Security
description: A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

title: Children of the Corn
description: A doctor (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend (Linda Hamilton) see no adults in a Nebraska town run by a crop of teens.

title: All I See Is You
description: In Bangkok, a young blind woman undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores sight to her right eye. Able to see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes her husband feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

title: Apollo 18
description: Footage recovered from a secret mission to the moon, which was funded by the Department of Defense in the early 1970s, reveals evidence of a terrifying alien encounter.

title: Gerry
description: After stopping their car for a hike, two men (Casey Affleck, Matt Damon) get lost in the desert without food or water.

title: Serving Sara
description: A woman (Elizabeth Hurley) tries to persuade a process server (Matthew Perry) to help her turn the tables on her conniving husband (Bruce Campbell).

title: The Grey
description: A pack of hungry wolves pursues survivors (Liam Neeson, Frank Grillo, Dermot Mulroney) of a plane crash, who are trekking through the Alaskan wilderness to find civilization.

title: Wish Upon
description: A teen (Joey King) starts to veer down a dark and dangerous path when an old music box grants her wishes that cause those closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

title: Donnie Darko
description: An unusual teenager (Jake Gyllenhaal) follows the instructions of the 6-foot-tall rabbit which saved his life.

title: Rolling Kansas
description: Three brothers, a gas-station attendant and a narcoleptic nurse embark on a road trip to find a marijuana forest.

title: Before I Fall
description: After dying in a car crash, a popular teen (Zoey Deutch) wakes up to mysteriously relive the same fateful day over and over again.

title: The Kentucky Fried Movie
description: Pop-culture satires include "Cleopatra Schwartz," "A Fistful of Yen" and "Catholic High-School Girls in Trouble."

title: The Air I Breathe
description: Inspired by a Chinese proverb, four fables revolve around characters who embody happiness (Forest Whitaker), pleasure (Brendan Fraser), sorrow (Sarah Michelle Gellar) and love (Kevin Bacon).

title: Paper Man
description: A frustrated novelist begins to depend less on his imaginary friend when he forms a unique bond with a Long Island teenager.

title: The Compleat Al
description: A colorful reality marries an equally vivid imagination in a hilarious portrait of musician-satirist Alfred Matthew "Weird Al" Yankovic's personal life and career.

title: The Bodyguard From Beijing
description: A bodyguard's assignment to safeguard a murder witness is complicated by the growing love between them.

title: The Gambler V: Playing for Keeps
description:
S01 E01
Cardsharp Brady Hawkes searches for his son, who is on the run with outlaws Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid.

title: Murderball
description: Filmmakers Henry Alex Rubin and Dana Adam Shapiro profile members of paraplegic rugby teams in the United States and Canada.

title: Bloodfist II
description: The world kickboxing champion (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) retreats to Manila, lands in a mess and fights his way out.

title: The Infiltrator
description: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur poses as a money-laundering businessman to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar.
